annotations.title: Plan a same-project Style Sheet character change

description: Requires an approved AlertForge account connection. OAuth-aware clients should start AlertForge's secure authorization flow and ask the user only to sign in and approve. Setup: https://alertforge.ai/ai-agents#agent-setup. Free to call. Prices a character-region change on an existing Style Sheet WITHOUT spending credits. Use mode=edit for a small change to the same character; use mode=redesign when replacing it with a new character while preserving the rest of the Style Sheet pixel-for-pixel. Returns a single-use 24-hour plan and exact cost; show the quote and obtain confirmation before create_style_sheet_character_edit.

instruction.description: The user's exact character-change instruction, up to 1000 characters.

mode.description: edit keeps the same identity and changes details; redesign replaces the character. Defaults to redesign.

projectId.description: The existing overlay project whose rendered Style Sheet will be changed.
